# gws recipe: Schedule a recurring meeting

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the schedule-recurring-event recipe: create a recurring team meeting with attendees in two commands (events insert with a weekly RRULE and attendees, then verify with `+agenda --days 14`). Distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-block-focus-time` (solo focus blocks, no attendees) and `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-plan-weekly-schedule` (the weekly review ritual) in this lot: this one is the most common team-calendar gesture — a meeting with guests. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
